title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: administration fee amount by category
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product every approval of an acceptance under review books its administration fee in the same act, and the fee booked with an approval is the category's administration fee in full. An administration fee charged at an earlier approval stays on the account and does not reduce the fee of a later approval.

## Administration fee by category
| Category | Administration fee (USD per approval) |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 35.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 45.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 60.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 75.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 150.00 |

## Condition → amount
| Acceptance at the approval | Administration fee with that approval |
|---|---|
| under review | the category's fee in full |
| not under review | 0.00 |

## Worked case (hypothetical history, AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives)
An acceptance was approved, reopened after an amended declaration and is now under review again. The 60.00 administration fee of the first approval stays on the account. That earlier fee is not a reason to reduce the fee booked with the new approval.

## Points of judgement
- *Is the fee reduced by what earlier approvals already charged?* No; an earlier administration fee stays on the account and does not reduce a later approval's fee.
